# Paul Routier MBE

Paul Routier MBE is a former States Member, first elected to the States of Jersey in 1993.

Paul Routier MBE has participated in 3 elections since 2002:

- [**2002 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-routier#e2)

  Elected as Senator with 55.5% of the ballot.
- [**2008 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-routier#e10)

  Elected as Senator with 36% of the ballot.

  - [2008 Full Manifesto](http://jerseyelections.info/senators/paul-routier.html)
- [**2014 Senators Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/paul-routier#e19)

  Elected as Senator with 44% of the ballot.

  - [2014 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2014/paul-routier/)
  - [2014 Full Manifesto](https://web.archive.org/web/20141218031339/http://www.paulroutier.com/)
  - [2014 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BTDm3BSG9tY)

Links for Paul Routier MBE:

- Twitter : [@PRoutier](https://twitter.com/PRoutier)
- Wikipedia : [Paul\_Routier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_Routier)
